_meta.description: Stage 5 (Expert) for the universal Anaplan product Pre-Sales journey template. Earn-once-then-maintain designation model — Expert PSEs earn designation through contributive deliverables (solution-architecture case studies, client references, demo-platform / battlecard / discovery-pattern contributions, initial independent demo wins) and maintain it via ongoing demos + mentorship. Slots into the larger Pre-Sales template at stages[4].
structural_alignment_with_delivery: Same Model C structure: earn_set (required deliverables) → designation event → maintain_set (ongoing activities) → optional_set (recognized but not required)

Same six earn_set tasks mapped to pre-sales-equivalents: solution-architecture case study, client reference, pre-sales playbook contribution, initial independent demo wins, adjacent product overview review, adjacent product credentialing intent
Same maintain_set shape (2 tasks): ongoing independent demos + mentor a junior PSE
Optional_set adds a third option specific to Pre-Sales: competitive-escalation contact role
Phase = 'expert' (matches Delivery's phase change from 'doing' to 'expert')
persona_specific_calls: Earn_set 'submit-customer-project-overview' (Delivery) → 'submit-solution-architecture-case-study' (Pre-Sales) — structured account of one delivered customer demo-to-deployment story: discovery → light-config → demo → competitive context → customer outcome and architecture decisions. Becomes per-product knowledge asset.

Earn_set 'contribute-blueprint' (Delivery) → 'contribute-pre-sales-playbook' (Pre-Sales) — per-product pre-sales playbook covering demo-flow patterns, discovery patterns, technical objection responses, battlecard updates, light-config patterns for industry verticals.

Earn_set 'complete-initial-independent-deliveries' (Delivery) → 'complete-initial-independent-demo-wins' (Pre-Sales) — 2 independent customer-demo engagements (full discovery + light-config + demo + technical objection handling) beyond Stage 4, no senior-PSE co-deliver. Demonstrates self-sufficient demo delivery.
Maintain_set 'lead-independent-deliveries-ongoing' (Delivery) → 'lead-ongoing-demos' (Pre-Sales) — continued demo activity expected of active Pre-Sales Experts.
Optional_set adds 'competitive-escalation-contact' — opt-in role serving as the {{PRODUCT_NAME}} competitive escalation point of contact.
open_items_parked_for_later: Multi-product credentialing intent declaration — same parking-lot as Delivery and Sales (parent-journey work).
Expert maintenance review cadence — annual / on-demand / activity-driven. Program-level operational decision.
Loss of Expert status — what triggers it, what the recovery path is.
Per-product pre-sales playbook review process — which CoE / pre-sales enablement team owns reviewing and accepting playbook contributions.
Solution-architecture case study standard — template/format for the structured case study document.
Client reference sponsorship process — operational integration with Anaplan customer reference programs (shared with Delivery and Sales).
Competitive-escalation point operational scope — definition of escalation triggers, response SLA, compensation/recognition for escalation work.
User direction: 'your recommendations are fine for now and will be adjusted later after review' — this Stage 5 design is a starting point, expected to be refined.

_note: Stage 5 task structure is FIXED across all product journeys within the Pre-Sales persona. Adjacent product references are VARIABLE per product. Asset templates (solution-architecture case study, pre-sales playbook contribution) are fixed; specific contributions are per-Expert.
name: Expert
_terminal_outcome_example_ifp: Finance Pre-Sales Expert designation → FCR and Connected Planning Champion pre-sales pathways
_designation_model_note: Model C — same as Delivery and Sales. Expert designation is EARNED by completing the earn_set tasks (contributive deliverables that convert individual pre-sales experience into ecosystem value), then MAINTAINED by ongoing-state activities in the maintain_set. Optional_set tasks are recognized but not required for either earning or maintaining the designation.
description: PSE achieves and maintains Pre-Sales Expert designation for {{PRODUCT_NAME}} by contributing structured deliverables back to the ecosystem (solution-architecture case studies, client references, pre-sales playbook contributions) and maintaining ongoing practitioner activities (independent demos, mentorship). The Pre-Sales Expert is no longer just someone who can deliver demos — they are someone who actively shapes how others demo, what battlecards say, and how complex deals are won technically.

earn_set.description: Required contributive deliverables. All must be completed to achieve Pre-Sales Expert designation.

maintain_set.description: Ongoing activities expected of an active Pre-Sales Expert. Status maintenance reviewed on cadence (TBD).

optional_set.description: Recognized contributions and roles that are not required for earning or maintaining Pre-Sales Expert designation.

tasks.title: Submit solution-architecture case study
tasks.description: Produce a structured case study of one customer demo-to-deployment story for {{PRODUCT_NAME}} — customer, business context, discovery findings, light-config decisions made for the customer's data, demo-flow choices and what landed, technical objections handled, competitive context, customer outcome and architecture decisions taken into deployment. Becomes a per-product knowledge asset future PSEs can learn from. Distinct from Stage 4 engagement artifacts (which were per-engagement advisory reviews) — this is a full solution-architecture story.
tasks._completion_mechanism_note: PSM + pre-sales enablement reviews the case study against the standard format and accepts it as a per-product knowledge asset.
examples_of_good_output: Customer: Mid-market manufacturer (5,000 employees). Business context: 12 cost centers, fragmented quarterly close. Discovery: surfaced 8 weeks of close-cycle pain. Light-config: loaded their org/hierarchy/product taxonomy into IFP demo env to mirror real reporting structure. Demo flow: led with rolling-forecast scenario most relevant to their CFO. Technical objection: 'how do you handle our existing Hyperion data model' — countered with integration-pattern walk-through. Outcome: 9-week sales cycle to deployment-ready.

Customer: Global retailer (40,000 employees). Business context: revenue-planning across 6 regions with regional-finance autonomy. Discovery: surfaced regional-fragmentation requirement. Light-config: built region-specific hierarchy variants in demo env. Competitive: head-to-head vs Workday Adaptive — won on multi-region demo-time scalability. Architecture decision: phased deployment to preserve regional autonomy.

tasks.title: Sponsor a client reference
tasks.description: Sponsor at least one customer reference. Customer agrees to be referenced for the {{PRODUCT_NAME}} solution architecture and demo experience. Real signal — the customer is willing, the partner has the relationship, and the engagement was successful enough to warrant referencing.
tasks.deliverable: Customer reference confirmation (customer-acknowledged willingness to be referenced)
tasks._completion_mechanism_note: PSM confirms the reference is sponsored and integrated into Anaplan's customer reference program.
examples_of_good_output: Customer X agrees to participate in 1-2 prospect reference calls per quarter (technical track) and to be named in case study materials. Reference scope: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} architecture decisions, deployment timeline, and technical outcomes specified.

Customer Y agrees to a video case study and Anaplan Connect speaking opportunity (technical track). Reference scope: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} multi-region deployment with adjacent product expansion architecture.

tasks.title: Contribute to {{PRODUCT_NAME}} pre-sales playbook
tasks.description: Submit at least one accepted contribution to the {{PRODUCT_NAME}} pre-sales playbook. Contributions can be drawn from Stage 4 artifact review feedback, solution-architecture case study learnings, or independent observation. The Stage 4 engagement reviews and the case study are likely raw material for playbook contribution.
examples_of_contribution_types: New demo-flow pattern (e.g., 'CFO-led discovery → rolling-forecast scenario → close pivot for Mid-Market Finance')
New discovery pattern (e.g., 'surfacing data-readiness signals during initial discovery')
New technical objection response (e.g., 'positioning {{PRODUCT_NAME}} architecture vs. existing Hyperion installation')
New battlecard variant (e.g., 'multi-region scalability talk-track vs. Workday Adaptive')
New light-config pattern for an industry vertical (e.g., 'retail product-taxonomy loading pattern')
Edit to existing playbook section (e.g., 'expanded technical-objection list with new architecture-pattern response')
tasks._completion_mechanism_note: Pre-sales enablement / playbook owner reviews and accepts the contribution.

tasks.title: Complete initial independent {{PRODUCT_NAME}} demo wins
tasks.description: Complete 2 independent {{PRODUCT_NAME}} customer-demo engagements (full discovery + light-config + demo + technical objection handling, no senior-PSE co-deliver, senior available on call only). These are demo-to-customer-progression wins beyond the 3 engagements from Stage 4. Demonstrates ability to deliver without senior-PSE scaffolding.
tasks._completion_mechanism_note: PSM + senior PSE confirms the demos were independently led and resulted in customer-progression outcomes (qualified opportunity advanced, technical-fit confirmed, proposal-stage reached).

tasks.title: Review {{ADJACENT_PRODUCT}} pre-sales overview
tasks.description: Review {{ADJACENT_PRODUCT}} pre-sales overview content to inform the credentialing intent declaration. Provides context for whether to pursue, defer, or decline the adjacent product Pre-Sales journey.

tasks.title: Declare {{ADJACENT_PRODUCT}} pre-sales credentialing intent
tasks.description: After reviewing {{ADJACENT_PRODUCT}} pre-sales overview, declare credentialing intent. Signal-only — does not start the adjacent journey, only captures the Pre-Sales Expert's intent for partner-firm and Anaplan planning.
tasks._multi_product_note: v0 captures one adjacent product. Multi-product credentialing intent (for parent-journey enrolees) is parking-lot for parent-journey work — same as Delivery and Sales.

tasks.title: {{PRODUCT_NAME}} Pre-Sales Expert designation
tasks.description: Formal recognition moment when the earn_set is complete. Issues Pre-Sales Expert credential, badge, and announces designation in partner community channels.
tasks.deliverable: Pre-Sales Expert credential issued; participant added to Pre-Sales Expert directory; community announcement
tasks._completion_mechanism_note: Triggered automatically when all earn_set tasks complete. No participant action required.

tasks.title: Lead ongoing independent {{PRODUCT_NAME}} customer demos
tasks.description: Continue leading independent {{PRODUCT_NAME}} customer-demo engagements to maintain active Pre-Sales Expert status. No fixed count — review on cadence (TBD) confirms continued practitioner activity.

tasks.title: Mentor a junior {{PRODUCT_NAME}} PSE
tasks.description: Active mentorship of a junior PSE progressing through the {{PRODUCT_NAME}} Pre-Sales Journey. Requires named mentee and ongoing relationship.
tasks._completion_mechanism_note: PSM acknowledges the mentee-mentor relationship and confirms ongoing activity. Mentee may be asked to attest to the relationship.

tasks.title: Community contribution
tasks.description: Recognized contributions to the partner community beyond the required earn_set deliverables.
examples: Polished case study (beyond the structured solution-architecture case study)
Demo-platform improvements committed to the canonical environment

tasks.title: Register as {{PRODUCT_SHORT}} Pre-Sales SME
tasks.description: Opt-in registry entry as a {{PRODUCT_SHORT}} Pre-Sales Subject Matter Expert. Discoverable in the Anaplan Pre-Sales SME directory; eligible for community speaking opportunities, complex-deal solution-architect queries, and partner-firm staffing queries.

tasks.title: Serve as {{PRODUCT_NAME}} competitive-escalation point of contact
tasks.description: Opt-in role: when a partner or Anaplan team needs deep competitive-positioning support during a live pursuit (specific competitor in play, technical-bake-off, displacement scenario), the Expert PSE is on the rotation to provide structured guidance. Demonstrates leadership beyond own deals — Expert PSE sharpens the broader ecosystem's competitive posture for {{PRODUCT_NAME}}.
tasks.deliverable: Opt-in registration + accepted escalation requests logged
tasks._note: Operational scope (escalation triggers, response SLA, recognition model) parked for later. Recognition that this role exists; mechanics TBD.

gates.description: Solution-architecture case study submitted and accepted by PSM + pre-sales enablement (≥1)
Client reference sponsored and integrated into Anaplan reference program (≥1)
≥2 initial independent {{PRODUCT_NAME}} demo wins confirmed by PSM + senior PSE
{{ADJACENT_PRODUCT}} pre-sales credentialing intent declared (pursue / defer / decline)
Pre-Sales Expert designation issued — earn_set complete, credential and badge issued, community announcement made
Active Pre-Sales Expert continues leading independent {{PRODUCT_NAME}} customer demos
Active mentee-mentor relationship logged with named junior PSE

estimated_effort_total: Variable — earn_set typically achieved 6-18 months after Stage 4 completion depending on demo-engagement velocity and contribution opportunities. Maintain_set is ongoing.
_estimated_effort_total_note: Stage 5 is bound by real demo engagement availability, playbook contribution opportunities, and customer reference relationships — not participant work hours.

_per_product_authoring_obligations.description: Stage 5 has minimal per-product asset authoring. Per-product obligations are review and acceptance processes.

items.scope: Template/format for the structured case study document. Same template across products preferred.
Per-product pre-sales-enablement / playbook owner identified and review process defined.
Identify the correct {{ADJACENT_PRODUCT}} and {{ADJACENT_JOURNEY_ID}} for each Pre-Sales journey.

items: Expert maintenance review cadence — when and how Pre-Sales Expert status is re-confirmed against the maintain_set.
Pre-sales playbook contribution review SLA — time from contribution submission to acceptance.
Client reference sponsorship coordination — Anaplan customer reference programs may have their own gates (shared with Delivery and Sales Stage 5).
Mentee pool — Stage 5 mentorship requires a junior PSE available to mentor.
Competitive-escalation contact program — operational scope (triggers, SLA, recognition) needs definition before enabling the optional role.
Multi-product Pre-Sales Experts — under parent journeys, an Expert may hold designation for IFP + FCR + AI simultaneously.
